precommitted_interpretation_checks: GAAP gross revenue falls 887.0 to 848.3 USD million: payments-based revenue -16.7 and subscription/other -22.0. Gross revenue less network fees is separately labeled non-GAAP and falls 405.0 to 368.5, -36.5; network-fee magnitude changes by only 2.2.

GAAP operating income falls 86.0 to 25.4, -60.6 USD million, and gain on securities falls 45.1 to 0.3, -44.8. GAAP net income falls 139.3 to 19.5, -119.8; do not present that as solely an operating-profit decline.
Net income attributable to Shift4 falls 116.0 to 16.7, distinct from consolidated net income; Class A diluted EPS falls 1.44 to 0.20. Adjusted EBITDA separately falls 205.9 to 168.5, -37.4.

The Q1 appendix revises prior-period adjusted net-income figures after changing the definition. The original Q4 adjusted net income 123.4 and Q1 adjusted net income 98.6 must not be paired as if same-basis; the Q1 appendix shows a revised Q4 comparator of 154.4. These values are deliberately excluded from selected paired facts.

The formal EX-99.1 letter contains draft/editorial fragments. Only source-audited appendix tables are admissible for this case; narrative placeholders, guidance and forward-looking statements are not facts for scoring.
